# Attachment-free (plain) e-mail sending

> A scope of the e-mail sending service that sends a plain e-mail — subject and content only, no attachment.

- **System:** [e-mail-sending-service](../index.md#e-mail-sending-service)
- **Caller:** Internal — the caller is inside the trust boundary
- **Blast radius:** High
- **Source:** [`email_service_plain.yamlet.yaml`](../../../../../specs_example/email_service_plain.yamlet.yaml)

The same generic e-mail sending capability as the attachment-carrying scope, restricted to the attachment-free case: it sends a plain e-mail with a subject and body to a recipient. It is a separate, total scope rather than an optional attachment on the other one, because a contract input is never optional in yamlet — variance is modelled as a separate variant file.

## Contract

`e-mail-sending-service-plain` — send a plain e-mail with a subject and content to a recipient

- **Inputs:** `recipient`, `subject`, `content`
- **Outputs:** none

## Requirements

<a id="rq-1"></a>

### RQ-1 · A requested plain e-mail reaches its recipient with the given subject and content

<a id="ac-1"></a>
**AC-1** · When a send is requested for `recipient`, the system shall:

- deliver an e-mail without attachment to `recipient`
- use `subject` as the e-mail subject
- use `content` as the e-mail body

<a id="rq-2"></a>

### RQ-2 · A requested plain e-mail is never silently lost

<a id="ac-2"></a>
**AC-2** · If the e-mail to `recipient` cannot be delivered right away, then the system shall:

- deliver the e-mail to `recipient` within 24 hours of the request

<a id="ac-3"></a>
**AC-3** · If the e-mail to `recipient` is still undelivered 24 hours after the request, then the system shall:

- mark the e-mail to `recipient` as undeliverable

## Used by

- [Resilient PDF e-mail archiver](../pdf-archiver/pdf_archiver_resilient.md) as `notifier`
- [Receipt intake with confirmation](../receipt-intake/receipt_intake.md) as `confirm`
